metadata.description: Incremental build plan for marathon-ralph Claude Code plugin - Updated to reflect current state

group.name: Minimal Viable Plugin
group.description: Create the bare minimum to load as a CC plugin with one working command. After this group: Plugin loads, /marathon-ralph:status returns "No active marathon"

task.name: Update plugin.json with complete metadata
task.details: Added: description, keywords, version, author, mcpServers declaration. CHANGE: Added mcpServers section to declare Linear MCP dependency.

task.name: Create marketplace.json for proper registration
task.details: Added JSON schema, owner info, plugins array with category.

task.name: Create status command (minimal version)
task.details: YAML frontmatter with description and allowed-tools. Checks for .claude/marathon-ralph.json If not found: "No active marathon" If found: Display state info with Linear integration

task.name: Create README.md with basic usage
task.details: Comprehensive documentation with overview, prerequisites, quick start, commands, natural language, how it works, troubleshooting, architecture.

group.test-criteria: - Plugin loads with: claude --plugin-dir ./marathon-ralph - /marathon-ralph:status returns "No active marathon" message

group.name: State Management + Setup Verification
group.description: Add setup-agent to verify Linear MCP connection and establish state file patterns. After this group: Can verify Linear is connected and create initial state file.

task.name: Create setup-agent
task.details: Model: haiku (fast checks) Tools: Read, Bash, Glob 1. Check for mcp__linear__* tools 2. Test Linear connectivity via OAuth 3. Provide setup instructions if not connected 4. Create .claude/marathon-ralph.json with phase: "setup"

task.name: Create run command (replaces start command)
task.details: CHANGE: Renamed from "start" to "run" for clearer semantics. YAML frontmatter with description and argument-hint for spec-file Parse --spec-file argument or direct path Handles both start (with spec) and resume (without args) Added --force flag for session takeover Run setup-agent to verify Linear Create initial state file structure

task.name: Update status command to read real state
task.details: Read .claude/marathon-ralph.json Display phase, spec_file, linear info if available Handle all phases: setup, init, coding, complete Query Linear for live issue counts in coding phase Show progress bar and recent activity

group.test-criteria: - /marathon-ralph:run --spec-file test.md runs setup-agent - If Linear MCP not connected, shows clear instructions - If connected, creates .claude/marathon-ralph.json with phase: "setup" - /marathon-ralph:status shows current state

group.name: Linear Project Initialization
group.description: Add init-agent to create Linear project and issues from spec file. After this group: Can read spec, create Linear project with issues.

task.name: Create init-agent
task.details: Model: opus (complex analysis) Tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash + mcp__linear__* 1. Read spec file 2. Query Linear for teams (handle multiple) 3. Create Linear project 4. Break spec into prioritized issues (P0-P3) 5. Create META issue for tracking 6. For greenfield: discuss framework, generate init.sh, CLAUDE.md 7. Initialize git if needed 8. Update state file with Linear metadata

task.name: Update run command to run init-agent
task.details: After setup-agent succeeds: - Run init-agent with spec file path - Update state to phase: "init" then "coding" Handle resume case (existing state with phase: "coding") ADDED: Session ownership checks for resume

task.name: Update status command for Linear integration
task.details: Query Linear for issue counts (Done, In Progress, Todo) Show current issue being worked on Calculate progress percentage Display recent activity from META issue

group.test-criteria: - /marathon-ralph:run --spec-file spec.md creates Linear project - Issues are created with proper structure (title, description, acceptance criteria) - META issue created for tracking - State file updated with Linear IDs - /marathon-ralph:status shows accurate Linear counts

group.name: Core Coding Loop
group.description: Add verify, plan, and code agents for the main development workflow. After this group: Can pick up issues and implement features (without tests).

task.name: Create verify-agent
task.details: Model: sonnet Tools: Read, Bash, Glob, Grep 1. Detect project type from package.json/pyproject.toml 2. Run unit tests, integration tests, E2E tests 3. Run linter and type checker 4. On failure: create NEW bug issue in Linear (not reopen) 5. Return structured JSON status report ADDED: Detects Playwright/Cypress for E2E

task.name: Create plan-agent
task.details: Model: sonnet Tools: Read, Glob, Grep 1. Read issue from Linear 2. Explore codebase for related files 3. Create step-by-step implementation plan 4. Document assumptions as Linear comment 5. Output structured plan with tables

task.name: Create code-agent
task.details: Model: sonnet Tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash 1. Follow plan from plan-agent 2. Write code following CLAUDE.md conventions 3. Verify implementation manually 4. Commit with Linear issue reference ADDED: Proper commit message format with HEREDOC

task.name: Update run command with coding loop
task.details: After init completes (or on resume): 1. Run verify-agent 2. Query Linear for next Todo issue 3. Run plan-agent 4. Run code-agent 5. Mark issue Done in Linear 6. Update META issue with session notes Loop stops after one issue (hooks will continue) ADDED: Exit after single issue (critical instruction)

group.test-criteria: - verify-agent detects project type and runs checks - plan-agent creates implementation plan from issue - code-agent implements feature and commits - Issue status updated in Linear - One complete issue cycle works end-to-end

group.name: Testing Agents
group.description: Add test-agent and qa-agent for comprehensive test coverage. After this group: Features get unit tests and E2E tests.

task.name: Create test-agent
task.details: Model: sonnet Tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash Skills: setup-vitest (NEW reference) 1. Check for test framework; use setup-vitest skill if not configured 2. Review recent implementation 3. Check acceptance criteria 4. Write unit tests following Testing Library best practices 5. Write integration tests if applicable 6. Run tests to verify passing 7. Commit test files ADDED: Testing Library query priority, Kent C. Dodds philosophy

task.name: Create qa-agent
task.details: Model: sonnet Tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash Skills: setup-playwright, write-playwright-test (NEW references) 1. Check if web project (skip if not) 2. Check for Playwright; use setup-playwright skill if not configured 3. Use write-playwright-test skill for patterns 4. Review feature from user perspective 5. Create E2E tests using fixtures and Page Object Model 6. Write tests with accessibility-first queries (getByRole) 7. Run and verify E2E tests 8. Commit E2E test files ADDED: Fixture patterns, web-first assertions

task.name: Update run command to include test agents
task.details: After code-agent completes: 1. Run test-agent 2. Run qa-agent (if web project) 3. Then mark issue Done ADDED: Run agent using Agent tool

task.name: Create setup-vitest skill
task.details: NEW: Not in original plan Provides guidance for configuring Vitest with Testing Library: - Installation commands (ni -D vitest @testing-library/*) - Configuration template (vitest.config.ts) - Setup file (tests/setup.ts) - Testing Library query priority - Kent C. Dodds testing philosophy

task.name: Create setup-playwright skill
task.details: NEW: Not in original plan Provides guidance for configuring Playwright: - Installation commands - Configuration template (playwright.config.ts) - Directory structure (fixtures, pages, specs) - Authentication setup pattern - GitHub Actions CI workflow - Custom fixtures example

task.name: Create write-playwright-test skill
task.details: NEW: Not in original plan Provides guidance for writing Playwright tests: - Query priority (accessibility-first: getByRole, getByLabel) - Fixture patterns (auth, database, worker-scoped) - Page Object Model examples - Web-first assertions - Common patterns (network, upload, dialogs) - Anti-patterns to avoid

group.test-criteria: - test-agent writes appropriate unit tests - test-agent uses setup-vitest skill when no framework exists - qa-agent creates E2E tests for web projects - qa-agent uses setup-playwright skill when no Playwright exists - qa-agent skips gracefully for non-web projects - All tests pass before issue marked Done

group.name: Continuous Operation (Stop Hook)
group.description: Add hooks for continuous autonomous operation across sessions. After this group: Marathon continues automatically until all issues Done.

task.name: Create hooks.json configuration
task.details: Configure Stop hook to run stop-hook.sh Use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} for path resolution ADDED: Description field explaining purpose

task.name: Create stop-hook.sh script
task.details: 1. Read input from stdin (JSON) 2. Extract session_id from stdin 3. Check for .claude/marathon-ralph.json 4. If not active or complete: allow exit 5. SESSION SCOPING (NEW): - If no session_id in state: claim ownership, then block - If session_id matches: block exit (we own it) - If session_id differs: allow exit (not our marathon) 6. Check iteration limit (100 max) 7. Return JSON to block exit with continuation prompt ADDED: Session ownership with session_id

task.name: Make stop-hook.sh executable
task.details: chmod +x the script (assumed done during creation)

group.test-criteria: - Stop hook blocks exit when marathon is active AND owned by session - Stop hook allows exit when marathon owned by different session - Stop hook claims ownership of unclaimed marathons - Stop hook allows exit when marathon is complete/inactive - Iteration safety limit prevents infinite loops - Continuation prompt includes next steps

group.name: Natural Language + Cancel
group.description: Add skill for natural language invocation and cancel command. After this group: Full feature parity with plan.

task.name: Create marathon-ralph skill
task.details: YAML frontmatter with description and triggers Trigger phrases: "marathon this", "build from spec", "autonomous development", "keep coding until done", "marathon development" Document usage and prerequisites Map natural language to commands CHANGE: References /marathon-ralph:run instead of :start

task.name: Create cancel command
task.details: 1. Check for active marathon 2. Confirm with user 3. Set active: false in state file (keep phase as-is) 4. Add final note to META issue 5. Do NOT delete Linear project ADDED: Clear instructions about preserving phase

task.name: Update README.md with full documentation
task.details: Complete documentation including: - All commands with examples - Skill usage examples - Architecture overview with table - Troubleshooting section (collapsible) - How hooks work - Session scoping explanation - State file schema

group.test-criteria: - Natural language triggers skill correctly - Cancel command stops marathon cleanly - Linear project preserved after cancel - README covers all functionality

group.name: Polish + Edge Cases
group.description: Final polish, error handling, and edge case handling. After this group: Production-ready plugin.

task.name: Add error handling to all agents
task.details: Each agent has basic error handling documented in its instructions. Handle: Linear API failures, missing files, git conflicts Provide clear error messages Graceful degradation where possible TODO: More comprehensive error scenarios testing

task.name: Add CLAUDE.md for plugin development
task.details: Developer documentation for contributing Plugin architecture overview Testing instructions for the plugin itself How to extend with new agents/skills

task.name: Create sample spec file for testing
task.details: CHANGE: Uses comprehensive todo app specification instead of simple example. Full-featured spec with Turborepo, Next.js 15, oRPC, Drizzle, shadcn/ui. Demonstrates complete specification format with all sections.

task.name: Add assets/banner
task.details: CHANGE: Using .jpg instead of .png Visual asset for marketplace listing

task.name: Add .mcp.json configuration
task.details: NEW: Not in original plan Declares Linear MCP server dependency for the plugin Enables automatic MCP server discovery

task.name: End-to-end testing with real application build
task.details: Run full marathon with examples/app_spec.txt Verify complete flow from spec to working application Document any issues discovered

group.test-criteria: - [x] Sample spec works with plugin - [x] Assets present - [x] MCP configuration present - [ ] All error cases handled gracefully - [ ] Documentation complete for contributors - [ ] End-to-end tested with real application build

dependencies.note:
Groups must be completed in order (1 -> 2 -> 3 -> ... -> 8). Each group depends on the previous group being complete. Within a group, tasks can often be done in parallel.

Team selection works when user has multiple Linear teams
Verification runs before each new issue
Regressions create new linked bug issues (not reopen)
Each agent completes its designated task
Stop hook continues marathon until all issues Done
Session scoping prevents conflicts between sessions
Natural language invocation works via skill
Greenfield projects get init.sh and CLAUDE.md
Git commits reference Linear issue IDs
META issue tracks session handoff notes
Testing skills help set up Vitest and Playwright
Full end-to-end test with real application build

change.why: Clearer semantics - "run" works for both starting new and resuming existing marathons
Prevent marathon hijacking by other Claude sessions in same directory
Provide reusable test framework configuration guidance
Declare Linear MCP dependency for plugin

change.what: Example spec is comprehensive todo app instead of simple example
change.why: Better demonstrates full specification format with real-world complexity
